g.text: Movement outcomes: all attempts, including lethal payments
Campaign 017, ticks 1–100. Every world shown separately; bar widths use each world's own attempt count.
A death on payment occurs before destination selection; it is not an occupied-target block. Basal deaths never attempt movement.
These are retrospective process descriptions, not independent action samples or a causal explanation of extinction.
